get.description: Authenticated supported proxy from an attached CLI catalog inside allowed roots; supports single byte ranges. Never streams originals.

get.description: Read the bounded provisional transcript tail and current movie matches. Never starts decoding.

post.description: Opt in to local multilingual Whisper Tiny live drafts and an automatic local full transcription after finalization. Never uploads to a cloud provider or downloads models.
Create or reuse (by audio/provider/settings fingerprint) a durable transcription run. Cloud runs require explicit upload acknowledgement and a hard USD ceiling; no fallback.
Readiness and worst-case cost; never sends audio or loads a model.

Import or reuse a historical rendered-artifact review under contract historicalRenderedArtifactReviewV1. It can never be read back as a strict review target; a snapshot already stored under the other contract returns 409 review_target_contract_conflict.

Non-mutating validation of a HistoricalRenderedArtifactReview v1 (#232): integrity of an already rendered movie only. Requires the explicit acknowledgement; current sources, constraints and renderability are reported as not established.
Import or reuse an immutable review target. Never overwrites; a conflicting reuse of a viewed artifact returns 409 review_target_conflict.
Non-mutating validation of a version-1 TV review target handoff against the shared Rust validator, freshness/availability policy and stored targets.

patch.description: Set or clear a cut display name without changing the verified snapshot, receipt, recording bindings, or revision.
